Cookie Policy

Last updated: July 31, 2026

What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit websites. They help sites remember your preferences and understand how visitors use the site.

How We Use Cookies

Type Purpose Duration
Essential Site functionality (dark mode preference, calculator inputs). Session / 1 year
Analytics Understand visitor behavior via Google Analytics. 2 years
Advertising Display relevant ads via Google AdSense. 13 months

Managing Cookies

You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings:

  • Google Chrome
  • Mozilla Firefox
  • Safari
  • Microsoft Edge

Opting Out of Personalized Ads

You can opt out of personalized advertising from Google at Google Ad Settings.
